profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AWS | Healthcare IT | Cloud & Enterprise Systems
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer, developing React/Redux/Node applications, robust distributed systems and high-performance data pipelines such as Kafka. Developing solutions for container orchestration and monitoring, contributing to open-source development tools, engaged in front-end development / state management and back-end development / database management. 

Passionate about sharing my knowledge and contributing to the open source community to support global innovation. 

Recent talks include "Streaming Protocols" sponsored by Single Sprout.

Fun Fact: I setup a linux computer in 2000 because I didn't want to run Windows with Norton Antivirus!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded development of mission-critical web applications with React to manage insurance platforms across Florida Blue and Truli tenant Ids.
• Implemented NodeJs backend services for cost transparency features, including new API endpoints with custom parameters, enhancing Swagger documentation, and optimizing service logic for seamless front-end integration.
• Managed and Optimized CI/CD staging pipelines via Jenkins, reducing deployment times by 50%, streamlining code integration and boosting sprint delivery speed.
• Delivered user-facing features across Florida Blue and Truli platforms using React.js, on a MERN stack, translating Figma designs into pixel-perfect, accessible components while aligning with brand and UX guidelines.
• Built and optimized backend services powering cost transparency features, enabling frontend teams to display real-time medical estimates in compliance with federal regulations.
• Architected secure, scalable RESTful APIs and implemented React Router for seamless navigation, aligning with best practices in high-performance web apps.
• Enhanced frontend performance optimization initiatives, reducing page load times by 40% with Redux, and Webpack enhancements.
• Authored comprehensive onboarding documentation, reducing new hire ramp-up time by 30%.
• Developed web user interface features for insurance platforms using React, leveraging its robust component-based architecture to construct banners, deductible limits and numerous UI rules for both individual and family plans in-network. These code features were uniquely tailored for 2 sites: Florida Blue and Truli, with i18n languages in English and Spanish.
• Employed a UI toolkit for building high-quality, seamless user interfaces that enhanced the accessibility and user-friendliness of the platform in 2 tenant Ids.
• Led artifact repository management using JFrog Artifactory to enhance build efficiency and software reliability, ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · React.js · Redux.js · Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development · API Development · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Utilized AWS to implement a Kafka data stream, to optimize dataflow and application development in the cloud as a seamless data throughput.
• Employed CloudWatch, S3, EC2, MSK, Elastic Beanstalk, and IAM to retrieve account metrics and provide developers access and privileges.
• Architected a Kafka monitoring and observability application to track the health of the Kafka cluster, while providing a visual representation of the consumer/ producer health, schemas, and data streams.
• Implemented React to build a modular frontend architecture to streamline state across the application and to dynamically update availability of statistical graph and chart updates received on a minute-by-minute basis.
• Leveraged Java to install automated data streaming to feed data into Kafka to ensure application stability and technical efficacy.
• Implemented Zookeeper to control the Kafka nodes in order to maintain cluster health, configuration of Kafka topics and cluster management on the AWS EC2 platform.
• Containerized the application with Docker and deployed on the web to enable the team to have a robust DevOps experience.
• Product developed under tech accelerator OSLabs (opensourcelabs.io)
positions.insights: Skills: Java · TypeScript · JavaScript · Kafka · Git · Scrum · Prometheus · SQL · OAuth · Express.js · Webpack · Node.js · AWS · GitHub · Token Authentication · HTML/CSS · Docker · React.js

positions.title: RestauWant - An App To Find The Restaurant You Want
positions.description:
• Leveraged React/Redux architecture to implement Redux’s observer pattern, to reduce runtime errors while eliminating inefficient prop drilling and rendering of components.
• Cleaned large amounts of JSON data from external API into data usable by the database to allow for efficient querying of data to be used in a custom searchable filter using locations near the user.
• Leveraged MongoDB and Atlas for rapid deployment server-side storage methods, to store user data securely and efficiently.
• Integrated Google's OAuth2.0 to provide users the authentication, sessions, chat, and persistent login through passwords, and usernames to enable fast and secure login.

positions.title: CheetCode - A Daily Learning Algo Site For Developers
positions.description:
• Established uniformity and modularity with React to provide a better user experience and to ensure ease of scalability of the codebase throughout the application and to take advantage of the immutable, unidirectional data flow.
• Tested components with the Storybook Testing Library on frontend React components individually before creating other components to easily refactor and improve code readability and maintainability.
• Constructed a SQL database, ensuring an ACID compliant SQL database, to store relational data and provide access to multiple clients that can update state and store previous code logs of solutions related to a specific user.
• Configured the webpack dev server proxies and configurations to reduce overhead of multiple fetches from the server, and enable hot refresh development experience for a quicker, more performant application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Greater New York City Area · On-site
positions.description:
- Drove project success by leveraging problem-solving abilities and strong communication skills while collaborating with business stakeholders to accurately gather functional and non-functional requirements.
- Led the migration of enterprise applications to a cloud infrastructure, reducing operational costs by 20% and improving scalability to accommodate future growth.
- Revamped clients responsive web application, achieving a unified codebase, which cut development time by 40% and significantly reduced maintenance costs.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Reduced page load times from 1 second to under .5 seconds by integrating CDN, enhancing client experience and efficiency.
- Led migration to equip the site to handle rapid traffic surges more effectively.
- Rearchitected multiple CMS sites and e-commerce stores, integrated Stripe for payment processing, and enhanced product databases, resulting in significant traffic growth for leading 7-figure clients.
- Developed videos with FCPX and Adobe Premiere and placed them using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, creating engaging rich media interfaces that maintain compatibility across various web environments.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams like Marketing, Design, and Shipping to streamline development processes, improving project delivery time.
